@@CONTbudget of $93,520. When the Brownlow Committee made its report in 1937, Roosevelt had thirty-seven employees in the White House Office and a budget of about $200,000. By 1967 the budget had increased to nearly three million dollars. The total White House staff for 1966 has been estimated to be 2,845.
